<thought>From the spectrum, the dominant peak at m/z 183 has a strong M+2 peak at m/z 185 with ~33 % intensity, matching the 3:1 ratio of ^35Cl/^37Cl, indicating chlorine. The M+1 peak at m/z 184 is ~10 % of the base peak, consistent with the cumulative contribution of many ^13C atoms, confirming carbon. No other element shows a characteristic isotopic pattern (e.g., bromine’s 1:1 M+2, sulfur’s ~4 % M+2). Therefore, the elements that can be definitively identified are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
